# ankra_cluster_stack_variables (Data Source)

Reads the variables a stack on a cluster is deployed with, whoever set them. A pending draft's values are never included; `has_pending_draft` says whether one exists. Set individual keys with `ankra_cluster_stack_variable`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster_stack_variables" "platform" {
  cluster_id = ankra_cluster.production.id
  stack_name = "platform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster.
- `stack_name` (String) Name of the stack.

### Read-Only

- `delete_pending` (Boolean) Whether the stack is being deleted.
- `deploy_wave` (Number) The stack's deploy wave; null when it has none.
- `description` (String) The stack's description; null when it has none.
- `has_pending_draft` (Boolean) Whether a draft of the stack is waiting to be published. A draft that edits stack-level fields replaces these variables when it is published.
- `id` (String) `<cluster_id>/<stack_name>`.
- `variables` (Map of String, Sensitive) The deployed variables, by name. Marked sensitive, like the resource's `value`.
